text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am Air Groove. Allow me to remind you…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I seek to embody the ideals of all Umamusume and become their guiding beacon. For, as the Empress, these are the heights I must strive towards.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The path is precarious, and affords us no time to waste standing still. Therefore, as my trainer, you must follow me closely and without ever losing focus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
